evidence: [carried from batch_218 as wang_2026_teaching_presence; verify_wang_2026_technology_perception.R re-run against the renamed live table 2026-09-27] Route 1-variant (published per-item statistic): recomputed each item's within-construct VIF from the live IRW responses (500 respondents x 8 items) and matched it to the VIF column of the paper's Table 2. Claimed mapping live TP1..TP8 = appendix TP1, TP10, TP11, TP12, TP2, TP7, TP8, TP9 (the alphabetical renumbering of the eight items retained after TP3-TP6 were dropped). Published vs recomputed: 1.874/1.8737, 1.974/1.9740, 2.032/2.0321, 2.231/2.2310, 1.919/1.9191, 1.913/1.9135, 1.999/1.9988, 2.122/2.1216 -- total absolute deviation 0.0016 over 8 items, max 0.0005. That assignment is the unique best of all 40320 permutations; the runner-up (swapping appendix TP2 and TP7, published 1.919 vs 1.913) scores 0.0127, i.e. 0.011 worse, and that pair is the tightest discrimination in the table. The method is calibrated on the four sibling constructs of the same deposit, whose labelling is not in doubt: it reproduces all 14 published VIFs of ATT (1.555/1.529/1.594), PU (1.626/1.554/1.500), TA (2.151/1.995/2.104) and BI (1.908/2.029/1.958/2.016/1.994) exactly to the printed digit, so the 0.006-per-item error implied by the runner-up is more than ten times the observed reproduction error. Every item is thereby distinguished from every other. Separately, the option_text direction for the two negatively-worded items was checked rather than assumed: live TP3 (appendix TP11) and TP5 (appendix TP2) correlate +0.532..+0.595 and +0.516..+0.579 with the other seven items, so they are stored already reverse-scored and their anchors ship reversed. NOT established: that the authors' own spreadsheet labelling is internally correct, and nothing about the administered Chinese wording (the shipped English is the fallback).

This also fixes the storage direction: an un-reversed secf_5m/secf_8m could not sum to that score. Route 6 (polarity): secf_5m and secf_8m correlate +0.09..+0.28 and +0.25..+0.49 with the seven other negatively worded items -- all positive, where raw positive-affect items would be negative. Route 5 (residual block): after removing the general factor, {secf_5m, secf_8m} is the single strongest of all 45 pairs at r = +0.262, 2.7x the runner-up {secf_9m, secf_10m} at +0.096 -- the CES-D's positive-affect method factor sitting on exactly the two positions the CES-D-10 assigns to it (5 and 8). Route 8 (semantic): most endorsed secf_4m 1.679 ('everything I did was an effort') and secf_7m 1.426 ('my sleep was restless'); least endorsed secf_6m 0.776 ('I felt fearful') -- the CES-D's usual endorsement pattern. NOT ESTABLISHED: the order among the eight negatively worded items. Any permutation within {secf_1m,2m,3m,6m,7m,9m,10m} would reproduce every number above, and secf_4m's position rests only on the canonical order plus its endorsement rank (its item-rest r is 0.07 against 0.27-0.73 for the rest). Hence PARTIAL.
